test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following is/are advantage(s) of building dams?

i) Stores water for irrigation

ii) No equitable distribution of water

iii) Stores water for generating electricity

iv) Canals from dams help in transferring water to great distances

v) Benefits only to a few people
solution:
The correct answer is __**i, iii and iv**__

__
 
• The advantages of building dams include storing water for** irrigation, generating electricity, and transferring water to great distances via canals**.
 
• Dams provide a controlled water supply, which is crucial for agricultural activities, particularly in areas with irregular rainfall.
 
• They also play a vital role in hydroelectric power generation, contributing to the energy needs of a region.
 
• Canals that originate from dams help in distributing water over large areas, supporting both irrigation and domestic water supply.
